book.name: MAKI
book.title: Jisesi Kalaestida gala lalo Makimamo luhuwa jibo

content: Yuha nesa tili okaka wemu koha moloko ga.
Jisesi maya aku nohutoka maya lemeko mudaiboya wavu-liki wewena nisiki li esa ikayoko, noku lapeu maya yoweko no ilikaloka nedanaki muki wewena maya akeloka minayoko monoka wetome oko lo biye.
Sakiya minayoko, Jisesimamo koha moloko ga wavu-leko lo bidanaki makoya sa-loko lo biye:
Elilo. Yuha nesa tili okaka we makolimoya yuha nesa tili ekolo wiye.
Mijakuka maya woko tili omo nowiyoko, maloka lemo anulo jibo maya namasi nesa eliye.
Malokaya lemo ehada mupilalo mika asolasi neboto lemo jiboya, mika napa minamiboto nenako, enemane oko wileko yowiha,
ho maya lidanaki aya nesa maya luhawa hana wamidanaki opateko alala miye.
Maloka lemo lilihau jekoko wileko yowiha, lilihalimoya mi jemikaiyoko ihilawa jamiye.
Malokaya lemo mika lalou jibolawa maya dowa loko wileko yowiye. Sakoya wileko yoweko yawa makolimoya ihilawa 30 jiye, ito makolimoya ihilawa 60 jiye. Ito makolimoya ihilawa 100 jiye.
Edimoya dataki minune likima maya aya monawaya eli wehe lilo, loko liye. 1 Luk 5:1-3
Koha moloko ga lo bekaka ibomidana monawa.
Maloka wewena maya alo wiki suwikayoko, oluho unala ipalaleki maloka wewena magoina minabosikiya aya koha moloko gamuya loka itikayoko, sa-loko lo biye:
Omailimoya ujapa olibetatibo onawamidana suna ibo gaya edimo elitae loko loneboya, hetoka minabolawasiya koha moloko gagoya elitae.
Yamuya Aesayamamoya ga mako sa-loko luhuwa jenebo ga maya edimotoka nisekolaiye:

content.text: Domudalotiya mudaikaka nesa liki mudataha, ma mudai wehe lamikilae.
Ito datadunuya aha elikaka nesa liki elitaha, ma eli wehe lamikilae.
Duka li wili jamitaboya Omailimoya lihimanipoya le hulamideko aha minakilae.

content: Yuha nesalo koha moloko libo gamidana monawa.
Jisesimamoya le omeko unala ipalalesida sa-loko lo biye: Maya koha moloko lobo gamidana monawa eli wehe lamahe. Sa-ikiya maloka koha moloko gamidana monawa maya nena nena iki eli wehe litae.
Yuha nesa ihilawa tili okaka noibo welimoya monoka leko moneko tili noiye.
Yuha nesa ihilawa lemo anulo jibomidana iki minabo wewenasiya monoka maya eleko le madonipou molatune liki sa-inabo maya, Olohalimoya enemane oko niseko aya monoka maya hipo oko le hulokaka noiye.
Ito yuha nesa lemo ehada mupilalo jibomidana iki minabo wewenasiya monoka maya lahelepa iyoko enemane iki eliki li dukau molikaha,
dukauya luhawa le ilitamoko onawa minawasi minadeko, monokaya dukau nebokumuye liki kohaidi-liki wiki ulana molibitatabo onawalo maya enemane iki limiki udatabo ne.
Ito lilihau lemebomidana iki minatabo wewenasiya monokaya elitaha,

ma mikauti nesalimo eda delokaka noibo nesaya, ito ehadamu dumu helekaka noibo nesalimoya, ito aito-aitomidana nesalimoya dukau minoko dumu helekaka noibo nesalimoya dukauya minokadanaki, monokamidana maya jeko hitomikaiyoko. monoka ihilawa maya edimotoka soto pamiye.

Ito mika lalou lemo jibomidana iki minabo wewenasiya monoka maya li pilikiki liminayoko, monoka ihilawa maya edimotoka soto pekaka noiye. Maloka wewenasitokaya napa apulu oko jekaka noiye, ito maloka wewenasitoka maya muki jekaka noiye, ito maloka wewenasitoka wavu-leko jekaka noiye.
Le jekakamu koha moloko ga.

Loko lokoko koha moloko ga mako sa-loko lo biye: Leya wewena makolimoya lepa okoko sipa iwaukahe, ito somo ulauka molokoko jeko hitamekolaiye. Lepa okoko maya molokaka noibo ebatoka maya moladeko, muki ebatoka lameda lekolaiye.
Ayamidana oko Omaimidana suna onebo nesa maya woko tolowa ametiye. Alikaya soto pitibogo ne. Ito halukuka netibo nesaki asako soto pe suwekolaiye.
Data golotonetibo wewenasiya maya nolobo gaya eli wehe liki elilo.
Sa-loko lokadanaki, edimoya maya galoya eli wehe liki elilo. Ga maya elitabo nesa leko Omailimoya monoka gaya libekolaiye. Ito yagoya minamiye. Leko isaloka yoweko libekolaiye.

Ito monoka dowa liki ujapa iki li-minatabo wewenasida maya Omailimoya ayaloya makoki le omeko bekolaiye. Ito monoka dowa liki ujapa amitabo wewenasiya ahago le-minupe liki litaha aku hipo okoko le eimolatoka molokadeko, ahanipo minakilae. 21 Mat 5:15; Luk 11:33 22 Mat 10:26; Luk 12:2 24 Mat 7:2; Luk 6:38 25 Mat 13:12; Mat 25:29; Luk 19:26
Yuha nesa wilekakakumu koha moloko ga.
Jisesimamo ga mako sa-loko lo biye: Wewenaya Omaimidana monoka oholauya yowekakamidana monawaya sakoya ne: We makolimoya yuha nesa mikauya tili okadanaki minoko,
voya wavu-leko udokadanaki yamidana monawa muda wehe lamiyoko, yuha nesa maya wileko yoweko napa noiboya,
mikalimoya eimola lulu jeko wileko yoweko napa okaka noiye. Api oko potoko yoweko aila jekoko ihilawaya jekaka noiye.
Sakoya ihilawa jeko halatoko lokaiyoko maya, leko natudawo onawa maya alili okaiye lokoko mida numuda litae loko doli hekaka noiye. 29 Joe 3:13
Masteti ya yuhamu koha moloko libo ga.
Ga sa-loko le koloko liye: Omaimidana oholau witabo wewenamuya nena nesalo lo moloko letuwe. Ya nesamidana iki minae loko nenahalo maya koha moloko letuwe.
Ya mako uliwa masteti yamidana ihilawa suda liki minae. Aya nesa maya liki moniki tili ikili niayoko maya, muki yuha nesasida asebetoko lasomosolasi neboya,
tili ikayoko wileko yoweko napa-napa oko liwana napakiya yowekaiyoko, namahenasiya nisiki akawau maya numudanipo vikaka niae.
Jisesimamoya koha moloko libo gamidana monawa lo biye.
Jisesimamo aya koha moloko gamidana wavu-leko alo elitabotoya monoka lo biye.
Ga mako lo bekolo noidanaki koha moloko gautigo lo beko mako alo elitabo nesa leko lo bamidanaki, eimola unala ipalale yuhakigo magoina minayoko yalogoya ga monawa lo soto moloko lo biye.
Jisesikaho liboto ahuhu napa nisibo haka libo.
Aya yupeka ludaka maya Jisesimamo unala ipapalalesida maya noku lapeuma alo yola helega wetune,

loko lokaiyoko li esa iki minabo wewenasida maya hulibitikiki noku lapeu maya yoweko neyoko unala ipalale yuhasiya ilimi-liki yola helega maya niwayoko maloka wewenasiya noku lape makomauya yowikiki demesalo moliki wae.

Sakiya niwayoko ahuhu napa-napa nisekoko no maya alahuka jeko hulo noku lapeu maya moloko nolimo waitekolo iboya Jisesi maya lemeko ulauka yeimaya madonaloya ya mako leko niseko madona jeikoko udoneyoko,
unala ipapalesiya ilimi sinikiki monoka ujapa wete yamalae, noku maya sima natudawo nesa noluniyo, emoya nenaha iyoko lemokumu elamoko aha minane liki lae.
Sa-liki layoko, Jisesi maya sinokoko ahuhumidana maya auha mekoko nomidana maya auha meko alahuka jamoko moletoko mino loko liyoko, lasi maya suwiyoko no maya apa jiye.
Sa-okaiyoko, unala ipalalesida maya auha beko nenahamu domoda wokaiye. Nemodamuya napa iki elewole iki data ki nemamahe, loko liye.
Loko lokaiyoko, domodanipo adoha wokaiyoko, edimonipo wetome-katome iki sa-liki lae: Agae, maya aitomidana we nenako lasima nebo ahuhuma neboya emo gala maya eli leiyolae, liki lae.
